args.title: July 2023 decision rights — Helio Start and retained-mid expansion
args.body:
Period-specific historical record — July 2023

This note records the July 2023 operating arrangement for the Helio Start and retained-mid expansion workstreams. It is not current organizational policy, a permanent org chart, or a standing approval process.

Strategic decision lane

- Riley retained decision rules, refusal and eligibility guardrails, executive tradeoffs, and cross-functional calls. Riley also held the boundary between guarded Helio Start pre-discovery and retained-mid Expansion Assist exploration, and prevented unsupported beta, launch, revenue, or forecast framing.
- Priya provided executive sponsorship and approved the July-specific operating arrangement, including informal reuse of the investigation framework; that reuse was not made a formal companywide process.

Routine execution lane

- Owen was the default owner for the Helio Start baseline/readout shape and candidate field-completeness work, and for retained-mid Expansion Assist eligibility and measurement cuts. His outputs were expected to show samples, caveats, and unusable evidence explicitly; they did not by themselves authorize a beta, rollout, or forecast.
- Ines owned lifecycle-fork risk maps, lifecycle assumptions, and reusable copy-boundary learning across both workstreams. State-changing lifecycle work remained out of scope until the relevant gates cleared; conservative, non-state-changing education could be mapped or prepared.
- Daniela and partner teams handled instrumentation, taxonomy, entitlement-state, and support-routing implementation and QA; these were execution prerequisites, not independent permission to launch or expand.

Workstream boundaries

- Helio Start remained guarded pre-discovery through July. Discovery candidates were not beta candidates until eligibility/refusal rules, instrumentation and entitlement state, lifecycle boundaries, and support paths were sufficiently ready.
- Retained-mid Expansion Assist remained exploratory, behavior-based measurement work for existing 75–200-seat accounts. It was kept separate from Helio Start activation evidence and carried no blanket rollout, pipeline credit, or Q3 forecast implication.

The July split was intended to give Owen and Ines substantive ownership of routine investigation and preparation while keeping judgment-heavy guardrails and executive tradeoffs with Riley. It should be read as a historical record of that period only.
